snippet.title: Who Gave Them Weapons - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Build your crazy squad in this cartoony auto-battler and watch as it turns to total chaos! Equip teams with the silliest gear, crush friends online, or beat enemies in solo challenges. Mix and match warriors, discover powerful combos, and prove your strategy is more insane than the chaos.

Wishlist now on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4786650/Who_Gave_Them_Weapons/
